name: Knowledge Base
description: Turn scattered notes into a searchable base and a queryable graph: build a sharded-index wiki with orphan/broken-link linting, and extract entities plus relations from Markdown into Mermaid or Graphviz output.
description_zh: 把零散笔记变成可检索的知识库与可查询的图谱：分片索引 wiki（含孤儿笔记、断链、空笔记体检）与实体关系抽取（可导出 Mermaid / Graphviz，附度中心性与连通分量分析）。
